summary: Exclude routing-neutral email headers from exact workflow-reference extraction while retaining visible evidence and content-bearing references.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving accuracy across RFI, Submittal and Email content
Confirmed synthetic reproduction where workflow-like From, To and Cc addresses created three false reviewer groups
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes continued RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy improvements.
known_limitations: Only routing-neutral From, To, Cc and Date headers are excluded; Subject and message content remain eligible for exact references.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no mailbox, model, external provider or customer file was used.
